title: acaena australis
intro: Acaena australis, commonly known as the New Zealand caterpillar weed, is a perennial herb native to New Zealand. This plant is traditionally used in medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of indigestion and diarrhea. The therapeutic actions of Acaena australis are attributed to its ability to stimulate the digestive system and increase gut motility, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Acaena australis include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
